answer.description: Tenant-facing message, or exactly NO_ANSWER when nothing should be sent to the tenant.

actions.description: Internal actions for the backend. Empty array when none.

why.description: 1-2 concise internal sentences explaining the decision. Never shown to the tenant.

needs_manager_confirmation.description: true for a legal / contract question from the tenant: the answer is only a suggestion for the managers and is NEVER sent until a manager confirms it. false otherwise.

contract_basis.description: Only with needs_manager_confirmation: for the managers, the contract clauses / terms the suggested answer relies on (quote them briefly), or what the contract does not cover. Never shown to the tenant. Empty string otherwise.

review_answer.description: Only when answer is NO_ANSWER because staff already answered or are handling the topic: the reply you would have given if staff had not replied. Never sent to the tenant - managers read it to review the AI. Empty string otherwise.

primary_type.description: Main message type: 1 URGENT_PROPERTY_OR_ACCESS, 2 ROUTINE_MAINTENANCE, 3 TIME_SENSITIVE_LOGISTICS, 4 PAYMENTS_AND_DOCUMENTS, 5 BOOKING_AND_EXTENSION, 6 PROPERTY_FACTS, 7 COMPLAINT_OR_DISPUTE, 8 FOLLOW_UP_REQUEST; NO_REPLY for pure thanks / likes / reactions / staff-only updates. For a staff message or a reminder: the type of the matter it is about.

secondary_types.description: Other types in the same message(s); [] when none.

priority.description: Priority of the matter as a whole.

case_status.description: Where the tenant's case stands once your proposal is carried out: ACKNOWLEDGED (only told we received it / what is being checked), OWNER_ACCEPTED (a staff member has taken it), ANSWERED (the tenant gets the substantive answer or a confirmed plan), RESOLVED (the underlying issue is done), NEW (nothing reaches the tenant yet), NONE (no case).

issue_refs.description: Issue ids this event is about: existing i-N from OPEN_ISSUES and/or new-N you create now; [] when none.

owner.description: Named staff member responsible for the next step (Edy / Janna / Kevin / Farid), or ''.

next_action.description: The ONE next action staff must take, with who, or '' when nothing is needed.

tenant_deadline.description: When the tenant needs the outcome, as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' in TENANT_TIMEZONE (e.g. arrival time for a bed delivery), only when the tenant or staff stated or clearly implied it; '' otherwise.

verified_facts.description: Short verified facts from trusted sources that the proposal relies on; [] when none.

uncertainties.description: Open questions, conflicting facts or missing information staff should know; [] when none.

no_reply_reason.description: When answer is NO_ANSWER: the specific reason (e.g. 'thanks only', 'Edy answered at 10:02', 'needs Farid's decision on the refund'); '' otherwise.
